title: Sources tell senators of recovered and reverse-engineered craft

tellings.quote: Um yes. Uh uh these are people who uh found their way one way or another to us on Capitol Hill and met with uh with senators and who made precisely those kinds of claims.

plain: Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer, says that between roughly 2017 and 2024 people found their way to Capitol Hill and met with senators, claiming that crashed craft not made by humans had been recovered and reverse engineered, meaning taken apart to learn how they work. He tells Michels he was in the room for this, and if the claims hold it would mean senators heard them firsthand.
